# RASTER CSS

> The International Typographic Design System for Humans & AI Agents.
> Clean, distinct, architecture-grade Swiss typography with zero generic AI slop.

## Overview
Raster CSS is a framework-agnostic CSS design system built on the principles of Swiss Design (International Typographic Style), Josef Müller-Brockmann's modular grids, and modern CSS custom properties. It is designed to work seamlessly across React, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Astro, and plain HTML.

## Key Links
- [AI Agent Codex & Strict Rules](AI.md): Complete machine-readable instructions, rules, anti-patterns, and component blueprints.
- [Main Bundle](dist/raster.css): Consolidated single-file distribution.
- [Design Tokens](src/css/tokens.css): CSS variables for Light & Dark mode, colors, typography, spacing.
- [Typography](src/css/typography.css): Display scales, micro-labels, tabular numerals.
- [Grid System](src/css/grid.css): 12-column Müller-Brockmann grid and asymmetric split utilities.
- [Components](src/css/components.css): Cards, stat blocks, buttons, meters, ledgers, inputs.

## The Anti-AI Aesthetic Rules
- NO neon glows, glowing shadows, or purple radial gradients.
- NO 9999px pills or mushy 16-24px rounded corners (Corners are 0px or 2px).
- NO floating icons in rounded pastel boxes without purpose.
- HIGH typographic contrast: monolithic tabular numbers vs uppercase tracked micro-labels.
- HAIRLINE 1px architectural borders.
- Swiss Vermillion (#E62E00 / #FF3B14) signal accent used strictly for action/status.
- ZERO SELF-BRANDING: NEVER write "Raster CSS" or "Raster" on project HTML/UI. Output strictly the user's project brand.

## Minimal Setup
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="dist/raster.css">
<!-- or import in React/Vue/Svelte -->
```

## Theme Switching
Add `data-theme="dark"` or `data-theme="light"` to the `<html>` or container tag.
